# Visa Sponsor Jobs

> > Global job board connecting international talent with visa-sponsored employment opportunities across 15+ countries including UK, Australia, Canada, USA, and New Zealand.

Visa Sponsor Jobs is a free, searchable platform that helps job seekers find work-visa-sponsored positions worldwide while enabling employers to reach 100,000+ monthly international candidates. The platform covers major visa sponsorship markets including Australia, Canada, Ireland, Netherlands, Germany, Portugal, Singapore, and more.

## Core Platform

- [Work Abroad with Visa Sponsorship Jobs. Globally. Easily.](https://visasponsor.jobs): Homepage for global visa-sponsored job board covering UK, Australia, Canada, USA, New Zealand.
- [Visa Sponsor Jobs](https://visasponsor.jobs/about): About page describing Visa Sponsor Jobs platform and its mission for international recruitment.

## Job Search & API

- [Find Visa Sponsorship Jobs](https://visasponsor.jobs/api/jobs): API endpoint for searchable visa sponsorship job database across Australia, Canada, Germany, Ireland, Netherlands.
- [Featured articles](https://visasponsor.jobs/api/articles): Featured articles on visa sponsorship, work visas, and immigration employment guidance.

## For Employers

- [Advertise Your Visa Sponsor Jobs with Us](https://visasponsor.jobs/advertise): Employer job posting platform reaching 100,000+ monthly candidates worldwide.

## Legal & Compliance

- [Visa Sponsor Jobs](https://visasponsor.jobs/terms): Terms of use and legal agreement for visasponsor.jobs platform by Teachers On Net.
- [Visa Sponsor Jobs](https://visasponsor.jobs/privacy): Privacy policy covering GDPR, Australian Privacy Principles, and data protection compliance.
